working_preferences: Content quality has priority over UI polish.
Advance a meaningful batch before reporting; do not stop after every chapter unless a real semantic decision is needed.
Keep learner-facing explanation plain and concise; hide engineering detail unless requested.
Backend content may be rich, but learner interaction must stay low-friction and high-quality.
For small scoped tasks, retrieve and modify only the minimum authoritative evidence required; do not expand into repository-wide archaeology without a blocking reason.
do_not_reopen: Do not make Suyi a second course or require the learner to read it separately by default.
Do not create a second AI Politics textbook that duplicates Chengfeng.
Do not let Xiao1000 question order replace the Chengfeng learning order.
Do not force different Politics subjects into one internal teaching template.
Do not turn first-round learning into indiscriminate fixed-formulation memorization.
Do not let Astro component convenience reshape canonical content semantics.
Do not add dashboards, scheduler taxonomies or memory machinery before acceptance evidence shows a need.
Do not log stable correct Xiao1000 answers into the Politics daily handoff merely because the runtime can store them.
Do not call Politics learner-ready because CI/build is green, content exists, question coverage is complete or a page renders.
